    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    Book
    Represents a single book in the private library collection.
    BookDao
    Data access contract for Book records.
    BookDaoImpl
    JDBC implementation of BookDao, backed by the book table in MySQL, joined with writer, genre and bookshelf.
    BookFormController
    Controller for the add/edit book dialog (book_form.fxml).
    Bookshelf
    Represents a physical storage location for books (a shelf in a room).
    BookshelfDao
    Data access contract for Bookshelf records.
    BookshelfDaoImpl
    JDBC implementation of BookshelfDao, backed by the bookshelf table in MySQL.
    DatabaseConnection
    Provides a single shared JDBC connection to the MySQL database.
    Genre
    Represents a book genre (e.g.
    GenreDao
    Data access contract for Genre records.
    GenreDaoImpl
    JDBC implementation of GenreDao, backed by the genre table in MySQL.
    IntroScreen
    The short animated intro that plays before the main window opens.
    Launcher
    Author: Farid Rahmani Contribution: Implemented a plain launcher class so the application can be started from Eclipse.
    LibraryService
    Business logic for managing the private book collection.
    LibraryService.LibrarySummary
    Simple read-only holder for the numbers shown in the Reports tab.
    MainApp
    Application entry point for the Private Book Library Manager.
    MainController
    Controller for the main window (main.fxml): the book list with search and filters, and the reports tab.
    ManageController
    Controller for the Manage tab (manage.fxml): add, edit and delete writers, genres and bookshelves.
    ReadingStatus
    The reading status of a book in the private library.
    ThemeManager
    Applies the dark luxury style sheet to every window of the application.
    VideoIntro
    Plays a video file as the intro before the main window opens.
    Writer
    Represents a writer (author) of books in the private library.
    WriterDao
    Data access contract for Writer records.
    WriterDaoImpl
    JDBC implementation of WriterDao, backed by the writer table in MySQL.
